review.scope: Recomputed all 72 training result JSONs, final E30, all 2048 current-phase transitions, 8 learning rows and 8 corresponding rollout observation arrays; compared W35/r24 and W36/r25 result JSONs and small stream records.
actions_not_performed: controller/runtime/environment modifications during the retrospective analysis

coverage.success_or_failure_selection: All episode outcomes retained; no favorable-episode subset.

review.source_commit_note: The fixed review HEAD is the merged evidence snapshot, not the commit first launched on the server. Source metadata changed during the job; the 72 result execution fingerprints and configuration hashes remained identical.
review.publication_scope: This retrospective evidence JSON is committed together with the W38 plan; its analysis did not execute controller changes or new experiments.

metric_definitions.natural_failure: reason starts with body_fall, invalid_contact, or material_domain_exit; external collection truncations are excluded from natural-lifetime/early-late statistics.
metric_definitions.body_strip_entry: stage_progress.material_traversal.west_entry_s is not null; the base reaches the original x=.8 m entry boundary.
metric_definitions.outbound_traversal_completed: stage_progress.material_traversal.completed; this field describes the original outbound traversal, not all hypothetical later passages.
metric_definitions.pann_nonzero_sample: Any nonzero component in obs reshaped to (256,658), last 12 channels; exact nonzero, no amplitude threshold.
metric_definitions.phase_elapsed_s: current job collection.updated_unix_s minus job.training_started_unix_s; not cumulative stream wall_s or delayed postprocess time.
metric_definitions.planning_share: sum timing.planning.total_s divided by summed episode wall_s; startup_planning is reported separately.
metric_definitions.batch_label: An update number identifies the update consuming the 256-sample batch. Samples were collected under the preceding completed update; episodes can straddle update boundaries.
metric_definitions.reward_sum: Undiscounted sum of logged per-transition rewards; W35 uses a different reward version, so cross-version reward sums are not an objective ranking.
metric_definitions.source_reference_resolution: source_ids refer to sources below; all repo-relative paths resolve at fixed_head. Release asset names and URLs identify the independent per-job records.

learning_accounting.conservation: 6545 collected = 6400 trained + 145 historical excluded + 0 active tail
learning_accounting.last_stage_status_note: budget_truncated describes the target-boundary episode classification; target_reached and training_checkpoint_complete are the actual successful collection stopping reason, not a 28-hour timeout.
learning_accounting.checkpoint_verification_limit: The ledger, saved transition batches and metadata were checked; checkpoint tensor payloads were not downloaded or deserialized.

cohort_comparison.interpretation: r26 reverses r25 prematerial backward-motion regression, but its forward exploration remains substantially shorter than r24. Fewer material-domain exits do not establish material-impact robustness because exposure and route extent are lower.
comparison_limits: Single continuing seed/stream; controller changes and reward changes are not randomized.
Natural survival time alone is not task success; r25 survived while retreating.
W35 raw lap counts are not evidence of legal material round trips.

W37_route_and_failures.torque_metric_limit: Episode maxima show that a limit was reached at least once; they do not establish saturation duration or simultaneous 12-joint saturation.
W37_route_and_failures.world_cell_count_limit: Allocated/nonzero world-cell count is distinct from cells ever carrying load; do not substitute world_cells > 0 for actual_material_loaded.

early_late_descriptive_comparison.excluded_episode_216: 2.5 s target-boundary truncation, excluded from the natural-failure comparison.
early_late_descriptive_comparison.interpretation: Mean maximum forward progress increases by about 1.35 cm, mean final x is almost unchanged, median natural lifetime decreases, and falls become more frequent. No consistent improvement is supported by this descriptive split.
early_late_descriptive_comparison.causal_limit: Unequal 36/35 natural-episode groups, one continuing stochastic stream, and overlapping policy-update episodes; no significance or causal PPO claim is made.

eight_update_table.interpretation: Optimization loss declines without corresponding route success, robust survival gain or a clear directional shift in mean cap. The records do not indicate PPO numeric divergence.

pann_signal_and_action_dependence.feature_units_note: Last 12 recovery features are divided by .001 m in PolicyMaterial.observation; the value above is dimensionless.
pann_signal_and_action_dependence.interpretation: Material loading did not usually yield a nonzero queried recovery feature, and feature zeroing barely changed E30 actions on the visited states.
limits: Sparse forward-only exposure is not evidence that PANN is generally useless.
Same-state action comparison is not a full counterfactual trajectory or causal material-benefit evaluation.
Exact nonzero count includes arbitrarily small finite values; it is not a learned-utility threshold.

terminal_credit_review.promised_behavior: Unfinished or illegal passage retracts its provisional positive lap credit.
terminal_credit_review.observed_code_path: finish calls LegalRoute.update while phase remains outbound, then emits result and terminal transition without invalidating the unfinished passage.
terminal_credit_review.fix_scope_recommendation: Finalize an unfinished passage on genuine physical termination before collecting the final reward and serializing the result. Keep dense provisional progress during ongoing motion and distinguish external acquisition/target truncation. Do not rewrite physical failure labels, completed legal traversal counters, or historical run results.
terminal_credit_review.causal_limit: This changes the terminal credit account; it is not proven to be the primary physical failure cause. All 71 natural episode returns remain negative, and the +38.3404 retained natural progress reward is much smaller than the -710 failure total.

final_evaluation.interpretation: The base fails before strip entry; final lateral position exceeds .6 m. The passage side-exit counter remains zero because strip entry never occurred, so zero side exits is not evidence of lateral stability.

timing.stream_cumulative_wall_note: This timer originates at the first stream collection and spans prior runs and downtime. Do not interpret ~398929 s as the duration of W37.
timing.W36_postprocess_warning: Use collection.updated_unix_s for actual stop; postprocess_started_unix_s is 3.20766 hours later and overstates training if used as its end.
timing.speed_comparison_limit: r26 average planner call is slower than r24 (1.0965 vs 1.0041 s), although overall sample throughput is higher. Reduced material exposure and different physics/material workload prevent attributing all throughput improvement to implementation speed.

inference_boundaries: Target collection success is distinct from physical mission success; W37 has no legal traversal or return.
50 episodes with foot/material loading are not 50 base strip passages; only 7 base entries were observed.
Fewer material-domain exits may result from shallower exploration and earlier falls, not better material robustness.
Loss decline and normal optimizer diagnostics do not establish useful policy learning.
The observed terminal-credit mismatch is real; its share of physical failure causation is not established.
Same-state PANN feature-zeroing is local sensitivity evidence, not a full intervention trajectory.
Torque maxima are not a saturation duty-cycle measurement.
Cross-controller comparisons are descriptive; episode exposure, policy history and reward versions differ.
Release evidence was read using the exact job asset names; three key text downloads were matched to the GitHub asset digest. No live machine state was queried.
The historical publication_pending status does not override the reviewed merge. The original job JSON is preserved as historical evidence, not rewritten.
No literature or paper result is asserted by this evidence JSON.
